offer.text: Do you know what day it is, my love? Our day. Bring home a cake and we'll mark another year together, just the two of us.

accept.text: Oh, you remembered after all. I'll set out the good plates.

decline.text: ...Of course. Another year, another forgotten day.

in_progress.text: Is the cake on its way, dearest?

ready.text: A whole cake! You old romantic, you.

complete.text: To another year, and many more. I'm the luckiest soul in the village.
